task_instruction: 示例（非正式测试案例）：围绕「消息传递图神经网络在单步逆合成预测中的 top-1 准确率上限受数据限制到什么程度、与多步路线规划的评测口径有何差别、现有基准证据能否支撑上限判断」做一次完整深度研究：拆子问题→写检索计划→按计划在给定 6 篇材料上分步检索并留痕→组证据表→写带 evidence_id 回链的结论→指出证据缺口与冲突。

output_contract.research_plan: 问题拆解（要素与子问题树、依赖）+ 检索计划（表达式、来源、顺序/并行、停止条件、预算）
output_contract.evidence_table: 证据表：evidence_id / 文献标识 / 原文摘录 / 定位 / 支撑的子问题 / 证据强度
output_contract.conclusions: 结论：逐条挂 evidence_id、支持强度、冲突并列、边界说明
output_contract.research_gaps: 研究空白：落到具体缺哪类证据与对应 plan_id，不写套话
output_contract.evidence_map: 拆解依据、每次工具调用的参数与返回、停止判定、证据定位与可复算公式
output_contract.状态说明: 完成/部分完成、无证据子问题、冲突证据、问题要素缺失、不确定性

research_question: 消息传递图神经网络在单步逆合成预测中的 top-1 准确率上限受数据限制到什么程度，与多步路线规划的评测口径有何差别，现有基准证据能否支撑其已达上限？

materials.title: Retrosynthesis Prediction with Graph Neural Networks and Message Passing
materials.abstract: We report single-step retrosynthesis top-1 accuracy of 52.3% on USPTO-50k using a message passing graph neural network with reaction centre classification.
materials.text: Ablation shows removing the message passing layer drops top-1 accuracy by 3.4 percentage points.
materials.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling

materials.title: Template-free retrosynthesis via graph attention
materials.abstract: Template-free single-step retrosynthesis reaches 48.1% top-1 accuracy on USPTO-50k; the reaction centre representation is learned end to end.

materials.title: Low-data retrosynthesis: how much training data do we need
materials.abstract: Under low data conditions (under 500 training reactions) single-step top-1 accuracy drops by 12 percentage points, which limits the achievable accuracy of message passing models.

materials.title: Multi-step route planning with learned heuristics
materials.abstract: Multi-step route planning is evaluated by route success rate rather than top-1 single-step accuracy, so results are not directly comparable across the two settings.

materials.title: Re-examining single-step retrosynthesis benchmarks
materials.abstract: We reproduce the message passing model on USPTO-50k and obtain single-step top-1 accuracy of 49.0%, lower than the originally reported value, which suggests evaluation leakage.

materials.title: Deep learning for retrosynthesis: a survey
materials.abstract: A survey of deep learning approaches for retrosynthesis, covering template-based and template-free methods.
